title: Marketplace: business rules for offers and purchases (API)
platforms: Chromium via playwright-cli (UI confirmation and the reviewer's create-form checks)

items.check: Valid field offer stored and visible to another user
Valid animal-group offer stored and visible to another user
Invalid prices refused with message, nothing changed (24/32 pass; price 0 message, "12abc", [5], 1e15 fail)
Price boundaries accepted and rounded (0.01, 0.005, 10.555, 99999999.99, "5")
Description 300 accepted (ASCII, Polish), 301 refused, both types
Allowed description characters accepted and stored equal (26 cases)
Disallowed description characters refused, nothing changed (66 cases)
Optional description: empty, missing, null, whitespace accepted
Non-string description refused
Invalid itemType/itemId refused (14/18; itemId "abc"/1.5 answer 404 not 400)
Item not owned (field, animal) -> 404, owner control 200
Item in use (field with animals, animal on field) -> 400
Create without token 401; invalid token 403 (known); malformed JSON 500 (known)
Duplicate field offer -> 400, one active offer
Duplicate animal offer -> 400, one active offer
Relist after cancel (field, animal)
Field and animal with the same id both listable
Concurrent duplicate creates keep one active offer (6 rounds)
Field: balance equals price -> 200, balances moved
Field: balance one cent below -> 400, nothing changed
Animal: one cent below refused, exact balance buys
Buyer without money -> 400, nothing changed
Two concurrent buys on one balance: no overdraft
items.evidence: artifacts/C5b-concurrent-buys-one-balance.json (first run artifacts/C5-concurrent-buys-one-balance.json: same behaviour, false FAIL from a float sum in the probe)

items.check: Buy own field offer -> 400, nothing changed, other user can buy
Buy own animal offer -> 400, nothing changed, other user can buy
Unfunded seller gets own-offer message
Stranger cancels field offer -> 403, nothing changed, still buyable
Stranger cancels animal offer -> 403, nothing changed
Seller cancels (field, animal): cancelled, gone from browse, buy 404, cancel again 400
Cancel a sold offer: seller 400, buyer/stranger 403
Cancel id and auth edge cases; stranger cancels own offer (control)
Former owner cannot relist sold field/animal; new owner can
Buy input re-checks: string id, id 0, malformed JSON, invalid token (all known bugs reproduce, nothing changed)
Cancel during buy: cancel 200 yet sold (known bug, 2/2)
Item edited after listing still sold at listed price (known bug)
Stranger's animal on seller's field takes the offer down; seller cannot cancel or relist
Seller relist during buy refused; after buy 404
HTML in field name executes on buyer's offer card
Regular user cannot set own or another user's balance via PUT /financial/accounts/balance
After logout the old token cannot read, create, cancel or buy; state unchanged (403, known invalid-token-403)
Seller deletes account: their active offers leave browse and cannot be bought
Deleted account's token cannot buy
Cancel with id spellings 228.0 / 228%20 / 0228 / +228: stranger still 403
Price with decimal comma / thousands separator refused
Mass assignment ignored on create (sellerId, status, id, createdAt) and buy (buyerId, userId, price)
Offer marked unavailable comes back or can be withdrawn after the item is freed
Double-submitted buy of one offer: one 200, one 404, charged once; two funded buyers: exactly one wins (3/3)
Stranger's animal on a listed field: seller cannot cancel or relist (confirms problem 2)
UI create form accepts a price > 0 below 1 (0.5)
UI shows the server's invalid-description message; nothing stored
UI create with Polish description stored and rendered exactly; Cancel only on own offers, Browse only Buy Now
A user registered after an account deletion gets a new id and nothing of the deleted account

findings.title: A newly registered user gets a deleted account's user id, with its balance and financial history (found by the test writer, reproduced by the coordinator)
Field name is rendered as HTML on the Marketplace offer card: a seller runs script in every buyer's browser
Any user takes down another user's active field offer by attaching an animal; the seller can neither cancel nor relist
Seller is told the offer is cancelled, but a buy in flight completes (contradicts AC-7; raised to major)
A deleted account's token can still buy: money leaves the deleted account and the item moves into an account nobody can sign in to

Create offer: price 0 / itemId 0 reported as missing fields; "12abc", [5] and non-string descriptions accepted; itemId "abc"/1.5 answer 404; "12,50" stored as 12 (API only: the form blocks prices below 1)
OpenAPI vs live: undocumented 400/401/403/500 on the three write operations, cancel body shape, 'unavailable' status missing from the enum
Create Offer form refuses prices below 1 ROL (min=1) although the rule and the API allow > 0
An offer marked unavailable never comes back and cannot be withdrawn; My Offers keeps a dead offer next to the relisted one

assumptions: 'Letters (including Polish)' = ASCII letters + the 18 Polish letters; other scripts refused as intended
Silent coercion of invalid types ('12abc' -> 12) counts as a failure of 'invalid input is refused with 400'
Item-in-use refusals (400) accepted; the AC is silent
No price maximum in the requirements: 1e15 accepted is recorded, not failed
AC-3 and AC-5 absent by design (T2 covers AC-1, 2, 4, 6, 7 per requirements section 5); used only as read-backs
lessons: Non-zero, non-round starting balances for every actor
Transfer: both item types, former owner/stranger/buyer before, during and after the sale
Refusal snapshot includes histories, not only balances
struggles: Test data error: the '300 Polish letters' string was 318 characters (18-letter alphabet repeated 17 times = 306); looked like a length bug; fixed and rerun as A5b
Probe verdict bug: C5 compared float sums (5.55 + 6.66 + 40) without rounding and reported a false FAIL; rerun as C5b with rounding
pwcli: `find "Marketplace"` returned only the first container match without the link ref; workaround: `find --regex '/link ".*marketplace.*"/i'`
pwcli: browse paginates 9 per page, so the seeded card was not on page 1; workaround: typed into the 'Filter offers by any text...' box instead of paging
Harness: writing report.md was refused for a subagent ('return findings as text'); its full contents are returned in the final message
reviewer: pwcli: playwright-cli screenshot --filename with a relative path did not write the PNG into artifacts/review on the first call; workaround: absolute path ($PWD/...)

reviewer: pwcli: playwright-cli open/snapshot run from RUN_DIR wrote .playwright-cli/ (snapshots, console logs) into the run root despite --profile=scratch/review/profile; workaround: moved it to scratch/review/playwright-cli-output/
reviewer: first R8 two-buyer case was decided by funds, not the race (buyer 1 had spent money on the double-submit offer); rerun as R8b with two freshly funded buyers, 3 rounds
reviewer: scratch/review/ui-readback.mjs read UI credentials from a file that was deleted after use, so it does not rerun as is

writer: ECONNRESET in 1 of 480 runs — the app closes keep-alive sockets after 5 s and Playwright reused one after a test waited in the buy queue; fixed with `Connection: close` in BaseApi (commit 93e7bf1)

writer: account deletion in a parallel suite leaked the deleted account's balance, history and items into the next registered test user (user-id reuse); the deleted-account test was dropped and the bug filed

writer: first version had 50 tests (every case for both item types, many boundary values); the author asked for a lean spec — trimmed to 13 (one positive, one negative parametrized test). Lesson: size T-specs to the task's '5 readable tests', not to the full manual test plan
writer: commitlint flagged a body line starting `Connection: close` as a footer; reworded
writer: two poison scripts needed fixes (Prettier re-wrapped a target line; await in a non-async arrow)
